map_quality.rationale: Carries over every retainer from Step 2 (14 rows, none dropped), classifies lifetime and goroutine crossings, and ranks WAL failover entries first — the process-long, goroutine-crossing hazards. specificity.rationale: Every row carries file:line, abstraction, carrier, lifetime, and crossing flag; top-risk rows (WAL failover) prove the injection site (db.go:908/950), queue store (failover_writer.go:176), and background goroutine registration (failover_writer.go:610, log_writer.go:595 flushLoop).
